placements.why: All three segments concern an organizational decision about analytics pipeline technology — adopting Zypherion, justifying it with quantified performance metrics, and committing to a migration timeline. This is architecture-level content: a technology infrastructure choice being declared and operationalized, and no existing strata category holds it.
placements.title: technology infrastructure and tooling decisions
placements.frame: What infrastructure and tooling choices is the organization committing to, and what do those commitments reveal about its technical direction?

placements.title: replacing analytics infrastructure for order-of-magnitude columnar query performance
placements.frame: What performance justification drives the organization to adopt new analytics tooling, and how is that adoption operationalized into a committed migration?
placements.why: src-1 declares the adoption of Zypherion for the analytics pipeline as a settled decision; src-2 supplies the quantified performance justification (15x faster columnar queries) that evidences the theme; src-3 operationalizes the decision with a committed migration timeline. Together they form a coherent theme of analytics technology adoption driven by measured performance improvement — a subject future envelopes will continue to feed as the migration progresses and outcomes are evaluated. The 15x metric is evidence for this leaf, not a leaf itself.
